bias.en: Bearish · broke $262–273, lowest close since Feb 2, oversold
bias.zh: 看空 · 跌破 $262–273，收盘创 2月2日以来新低，超卖

read.en: Teradyne fell 4.9% on Nov 2 to $261.01, its lowest close since Feb 2, ranging $257.84–277.76 on 1.5 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($293.7), 10-day ($307.7), 30-day ($364.6) and 100-day ($374.0) averages and the rising 200-day ($349.7). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($311.33), and RSI is 27, oversold.
read.zh: 泰瑞达 11月2日下跌 4.9%，收于 $261.01，为 2月2日以来最低收盘，盘中区间 $257.84–277.76，成交量为均量的 1.5 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$293.7）、10 日（$307.7）、30 日（$364.6）和 100 日均线（$374.0）以及上行的 200 日均线（$349.7）下方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$311.33），RSI 为 27，处于超卖。

read.en: A fade from the $277.8 high broke the $273.1 (Mar 30 low) and $262.3–266.4 supports, now resistance. Resistance is $262.3–266.4 (Feb–Mar and Oct 30 lows), then $273.1–277.8 (Mar 30 low, Nov 2 high) and $295–296.8. Support is $246.8 (Feb 3 low), then $240.7–241 (Jan 28 and Feb 2 lows). A close above $266.4 would target $273–278; below $246.8, $241.
